title: DAB Detection of Biocytin Labeled Tissue
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: DAB Detection of Biocytin Labeled Tissue
Biocare Betazoid DAB Chromogen Solution (SOP RP0266)
Single-well Receiver Trays (Millipore PSSW010R5 or equivalent)
Low-depth trays, 12” Pyrex dishes or equivalent
Orbital Rotator at Room Temp (Thermo Fisher 2314 or equivalent)
Orbital Rotator set up in 4ºC Refrigerator (Thermo Fisher 2314 or equivalent)
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
PF0289 Post Patch Clamp Slice Fixation

steps.title: Gather supplies and prepare reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all listed consumables (24‑well plates with inserts, serological pipettes, P20/P200/P1000 tips, 25 mm square spacers with 19 mm aperture, gelatin‑coated slides, #1.5 coverslips, small paintbrush, low‑depth tray, Kimwipes). Prepare fresh solutions on the day of use: 5 µM DAPI in PBS, 1 % H₂O₂ in PBS (45 mL per insert), ABC reagent (prepare according to the volume formula below and let stand 30 min, do not vortex), DAB working solution (0.05 % DAB in PBS, add 0.3 % H₂O₂ immediately before use), 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in PBS (1:10 dilution of 10 % Triton), and bring Aqua‑Poly/Mount mounting media to room temperature (≥30 min). Record lot numbers for QC.

substeps.instruction: 5 µM DAPI: dissolve DAPI to 5 µM in PBS; keep on ice and use within the day.
1 % H₂O₂: mix 45 mL PBS with 0.45 mL of 30 % H₂O₂ (or 1 mL of 10 % H₂O₂) to obtain 1 % final; prepare fresh for each insert.

ABC: calculate volume = (# slices in 24‑well × 1 mL) + (# slices in 12‑well × 2 mL) + (# slices in 6‑well × 3 mL). Mix kit reagents A and B as instructed, add to PBS to the calculated volume, let stand 30 min at room temperature.
DAB working solution: for each insert prepare 50 mL of 0.05 % DAB in PBS; add 0.3 % H₂O₂ (e.g., 150 µL of 30 % H₂O₂ per 50 mL) immediately before use; do not vortex.
0.1 % Triton/PBS: dilute 10 % Triton X‑100 1:100 in PBS to obtain 0.1 % final.
Aqua‑Poly/Mount: remove from 2‑4 °C storage, allow to equilibrate ≥30 min before use.

steps.title: Arrange tissue slices in insert plates
steps.instruction: Obtain the 24‑well plate with inserts that already contains the fixed biocytin‑filled brain slices in PBS (−) from 4 °C storage. If slices are still in a 24‑well plate, transfer each section to the corresponding well of a PELCO 24‑well insert using a paintbrush or transfer pipet, one section per well. Place the insert into a low‑depth tray filled with 40–50 mL PBS (−) so that the PBS covers at least half of each well.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Place the insert plates into single‑well receiver trays containing 40–50 mL of 5 µM DAPI in PBS (−). Incubate in a fume hood on a shaker set to low‑medium speed for 15 minutes at room temperature. DAPI is a hazardous irritant; wear gloves and eye protection and wash exposed skin for 15 minutes if contact occurs.

steps.title: Perform first PBS washes
steps.instruction: After DAPI incubation, remove the insert and blot 2–3 times on Kimwipes in a low‑depth tray. Transfer the insert to a fresh tray containing 40–50 mL PBS (+) and shake for ≥10 minutes (step 2). Repeat twice more with fresh PBS (+) trays for steps 3 and 4, each ≥10 minutes on low‑medium shaker.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Prepare 45 mL of 1 % H₂O₂ in PBS (−) for each insert. Replace the PBS (+) wash tray with the 1 % H₂O₂ solution and incubate the slices for 30 minutes on a shaker at room temperature. After the block, discard the H₂O₂ solution and refill the tray with fresh PBS (+).

steps.title: Perform second PBS washes
steps.instruction: Blot the insert 2–3 times, then place it into fresh PBS (+) trays for steps 6, 7, and 8. Each wash is ≥10 minutes on low‑medium shaker at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare ABC amplification solution
steps.instruction: Prepare ABC reagent 30 minutes before use (do not vortex). Use the volume formula from step 1 to determine the total volume needed, then add the calculated amount of ABC to fresh PBS (−). Swirl gently to mix and let stand for 30 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Example: for 10 slices in a 24‑well plate, prepare 10 mL ABC (1 mL per slice).
For mixed plate formats, add 2 mL per slice in a 12‑well plate and 3 mL per slice in a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Incubate in ABC at room temperature
steps.instruction: Dispense the appropriate volume of ABC into each well of a fresh multi‑well plate (1 mL per well for 24‑well, 2 mL for 12‑well, 3 mL for 6‑well). Transfer the insert containing the tissue sections into the corresponding wells. Incubate on a shaker at room temperature for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate ABC at 4 °C overnight
steps.instruction: After the 60‑minute RT incubation, parafilm the plates, place them on a shaker inside a 4 °C refrigerator, and incubate for at least 40 hours (≈2 days).

steps.title: Final ABC incubation at room temperature
steps.instruction: The following day, remove the plates from 4 °C, place them back on the shaker at room temperature, and incubate for an additional 60 minutes.

steps.title: Wash after ABC incubation
steps.instruction: Blot the insert 2–3 times, then perform three consecutive PBS (+) washes (steps 12‑14) using 40–50 mL of PBS (+) per tray, each ≥10 minutes on low‑medium shaker at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare fresh DAB working solution
steps.instruction: For each insert, prepare 50 mL of 0.05 % DAB in PBS. Immediately before use, add 0.3 % H₂O₂ (e.g., 150 µL of 30 % H₂O₂ per 50 mL) and mix gently; do not vortex. Keep the solution on ice until needed.

steps.title: Develop tissue with DAB
steps.instruction: Place a fresh single‑well receiver tray with 40–50 mL of DAB working solution. Transfer the insert from the PBS wash, blot 2–3 times, and immerse the sections in DAB. For mouse tissue incubate 3 minutes; for human tissue incubate 4 minutes 30 seconds, both at room temperature. Development is performed under a dissecting microscope: move each section into a petri dish containing DAB, watch for the target cell to become visible, flip the section to check both surfaces, and stop the reaction when the desired intensity is reached.

substeps.instruction: If using an alternate DAB kit, follow the specific preparation instructions (Table 7).
Do not add H₂O₂ to the DAB stock until immediately before use.

steps.title: Stop DAB reaction and final washes
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the insert to a fresh tray containing PBS (−) to stop the DAB reaction. Perform three consecutive PBS (−) washes (steps 16‑18) using 40–50 mL of PBS (−) per tray, each ≥10 minutes on low‑medium shaker at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount sections on gelatin slides
steps.instruction: Label gelatin‑coated slides with specimen information. Place a 25 mm × 25 mm, 200 µm spacer (adhesive liner removed) onto the slide; press firmly on all four sides to eliminate wrinkles. Using a paintbrush, transfer one stained section from the insert onto the center of the spacer, cell side up (mouse dorsal side up, human pial side up). Verify flatness and correct orientation with a dissecting microscope. If the spacer wrinkles, replace it before mounting.

substeps.instruction: If the section is too long for the spacer aperture, contact Electrophysiology for resection.
Record any use of a second spacer or resection in the “Biocytin_Version2” electronic form.

steps.title: Coverslip and dry slides
steps.instruction: Add ~130 µL of Aqua‑Poly/Mount mounting media into the center of the spacer (range 110–175 µL depending on tissue size). Apply a #1.5 coverslip by lowering the top edge at an angle, gently pressing to expel excess medium and air bubbles, then tilting to remove residual liquid. Press down on opposite corners to flatten the coverslip. Allow the slides to adhere for ≤1 minute before proceeding to the next slide. After all slides are coverslipped, let them dry horizontally for 24–48 hours at room temperature (protected from light) or at 4 °C (longer drying).

steps.title: Store slides and dispose waste
steps.instruction: Store dried slides overnight at room temperature or at 4 °C in a horizontal position, protected from light. After 24–48 hours, place slides in slide boxes or image them per SOP MC0135. Dispose of excess 5 µM DAPI solution in the designated DAPI waste container, retain leftover DAB solution in a properly labeled container for hazardous waste disposal, and follow institutional protocols for all chemical waste. Perform QC on new batches of Aqua‑Poly/Mount by preparing a test slide, drying 24–48 hours, and recording pass/fail before use in production.

substeps.instruction: Mark QC Pass/Fail on each mounting media tube and keep a check‑mark on the label for passed tubes.
Do not heat slides; avoid exposure to strong light for fluorescent chromogens.
